description: The webview may call this shell's daemon-bridge commands, plus the three notification-plugin commands needed to raise an OS notification for work that blocks a human (approvals and questions). No filesystem, shell, or network capability is granted: every effect rides the codypendentd protocol so daemon policy still mediates it (adoption 14 §7 gotcha 3). The notification grant is deliberately NOT `notification:default`, which would also hand the webview channels, scheduling and cancellation it has no use for.
